source.text: Ὑπομίμνῃσκε αὐτοὺς ἀρχαῖς ἐξουσίαις ὑποτάσσεσθαι πειθαρχεῖν, πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἑτοίμους εἶναι, μηδένα βλασφημεῖν, ἀμάχους εἶναι, ἐπιεικεῖς, πᾶσαν ἐνδεικνυμένους πραΰτητα πρὸς πάντας ἀνθρώπους.

records.literal_gloss: Remind them to rulers [and] authorities to be subject, to be obedient, for every work good ready to be, \v 2 no one to slander, peaceable to be, gentle, all showing courtesy toward all men.

en.L: Remind them to be subject to rulers [and] authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work, \v 2 to slander no one, to be peaceable, gentle, showing every courtesy toward all {{gender:people|men}}.
en.B: Remind the people to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready to do whatever is good, \v 2 to speak evil of no one, to avoid quarreling, to be gentle, and to be considerate to everyone.
en.R: Remind the believers to obey the rulers and people in authority. They must be ready to do anything that is good. \v 2 They must not say bad things about anyone, and they must not fight. They must be gentle and kind to everyone.

es.L: Recuérdales someterse a gobernantes [y] autoridades, ser obedientes, estar preparados para toda obra buena, \v 2 no injuriar a nadie, no ser peleadores, [ser] apacibles, mostrando toda cortesía hacia {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}}.
es.B: Recuérdales a todos que deben someterse a los gobernantes y a las autoridades, ser obedientes y estar dispuestos a hacer todo lo que es bueno; \v 2 que no hablen mal de nadie, que eviten las peleas, que sean amables y considerados con todo el mundo.
es.R: Recuerda a los creyentes que deben obedecer a los gobernantes y a las autoridades. Deben estar listos para hacer todo lo que es bueno. \v 2 No deben hablar mal de nadie, y no deben pelear. Deben ser amables y bondadosos con todos.

fr.L: Rappelle-leur d’être soumis aux dirigeants [et] aux autorités, d’obéir, d’être prêts pour toute œuvre bonne, \v 2 de ne calomnier personne, d’être pacifiques, conciliants, faisant preuve d’une entière douceur envers tous les {{gender:humains|hommes}}.
fr.B: Rappelle aux gens qu’ils doivent se soumettre aux dirigeants et aux autorités, obéir, être prêts à faire tout ce qui est bien, \v 2 ne dire du mal de personne, éviter les querelles, être doux et pleins d’égards envers tout le monde.
fr.R: Rappelle aux croyants qu’ils doivent obéir aux dirigeants et à ceux qui ont l’autorité. Ils doivent être prêts à faire tout ce qui est bien. \v 2 Ils ne doivent dire du mal de personne, et ils ne doivent pas se battre. Ils doivent être doux et gentils avec tout le monde.

sw.L: Uwakumbushe kuwa chini ya watawala [na] wenye mamlaka, kutii, kuwa tayari kwa kila kazi njema, \v 2 kutomsema vibaya mtu yeyote, kuepuka ugomvi, [kuwa] wenye kujali, wakionyesha adabu yote kwa watu wote.
sw.B: Uwakumbushe watu wajinyenyekeze kwa watawala na wenye mamlaka, wawe watiifu, wawe tayari kutenda kila jambo jema, \v 2 wasimseme mtu yeyote vibaya, waepuke ugomvi, wawe wapole na wawe na adabu kwa kila mtu.
sw.R: Uwakumbushe waumini kuwatii watawala na watu wenye mamlaka. Ni lazima wawe tayari kufanya kila jambo jema. \v 2 Wasimseme mtu yeyote vibaya, wala wasipigane. Wawe wapole na wema kwa kila mtu.

decisions.choice: rulers and authorities: the civil government
decisions.reason: As in Romans 13:1-7: believers are to be good citizens. Cretans had a reputation for unruliness.
πραΰτητα is meekness or gentleness, the quality of strength under control (Matthew 11:29).
ἀνθρώπους is the general word for human beings.
The word means human beings in general (m3).
Here the words mean the civil government (m1), so French uses the ordinary "dirigeants"; "principautés" is kept for the unseen powers, as in Colossians.
The English Literal has {{gender:people|men}}. Swahili "watu" means people and has no male-only counterpart that keeps the meaning (m3), so the setting has nothing to change; the same holds in 3:8.

source.text: ἦμεν γάρ ποτε καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀνόητοι, ἀπειθεῖς, πλανώμενοι, δουλεύοντες ἐπιθυμίαις καὶ ἡδοναῖς ποικίλαις, ἐν κακίᾳ καὶ φθόνῳ διάγοντες, στυγητοί, μισοῦντες ἀλλήλους.

records.literal_gloss: We were for once also we foolish, disobedient, being led astray, serving as slaves to desires and pleasures various, in malice and envy living, hateful, hating one another.

en.L: For we ourselves were once foolish, disobedient, led astray, enslaved to various desires and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.
en.B: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient and led astray, slaves to all kinds of desires and pleasures. We lived in malice and envy, hated by others and hating one another.
en.R: There was a time when we also were foolish, and we did not obey God. We were fooled by others, and we were slaves to all kinds of wrong desires and pleasures. We were always being mean and jealous. People hated us, and we hated each other.

es.L: Porque también nosotros fuimos un tiempo necios, desobedientes, engañados, sirviendo como esclavos a deseos y placeres de toda clase, pasando la vida en maldad y envidia, odiosos, odiándonos unos a otros.
es.B: Porque en otro tiempo también nosotros éramos necios, desobedientes y andábamos extraviados, esclavos de toda clase de deseos y placeres. Vivíamos en la maldad y la envidia, odiados por los demás y odiándonos unos a otros.
es.R: Hubo un tiempo en que nosotros también éramos necios y no obedecíamos a Dios. Otros nos engañaban, y éramos esclavos de toda clase de malos deseos y placeres. Siempre estábamos haciendo maldades y teniendo envidia. La gente nos odiaba, y nosotros nos odiábamos unos a otros.

fr.L: Car nous aussi, nous étions autrefois insensés, désobéissants, égarés, esclaves de désirs et de plaisirs divers, vivant dans la méchanceté et l’envie, odieux, nous haïssant les uns les autres.
fr.B: Car nous aussi, autrefois, nous étions insensés, désobéissants et égarés, esclaves de toutes sortes de désirs et de plaisirs. Nous vivions dans la méchanceté et l’envie, détestés des autres et nous détestant les uns les autres.
fr.R: Autrefois, nous aussi, nous étions insensés, et nous n’obéissions pas à Dieu. D’autres nous trompaient, et nous étions esclaves de toutes sortes de mauvais désirs et de plaisirs. Nous étions toujours méchants et jaloux. Les gens nous détestaient, et nous nous détestions les uns les autres.

sw.L: Kwa maana sisi pia wakati fulani tulikuwa wapumbavu, wakaidi, tukipotoshwa, tukiwa watumwa wa tamaa na starehe mbalimbali, tukiendesha maisha katika ubaya na wivu, wa kuchukiza, tukichukiana sisi kwa sisi.
sw.B: Kwa maana wakati fulani sisi pia tulikuwa wapumbavu, wakaidi na waliopotoshwa, watumwa wa kila aina ya tamaa na starehe. Tuliishi katika ubaya na wivu, tukichukiwa na wengine na kuchukiana sisi kwa sisi.
sw.R: Kulikuwa na wakati ambapo sisi pia tulikuwa wapumbavu, wala hatukumtii Mungu. Watu wengine walitudanganya, nasi tulikuwa watumwa wa kila aina ya tamaa mbaya na starehe. Siku zote tulikuwa tukitenda ubaya na kuwaonea wengine wivu. Watu walituchukia, nasi tulichukiana.

decisions.reason: Believers are to be gentle with outsiders because they were once like them.
δουλεύοντες is to serve as a slave.
The picture of slavery is kept (m2): this is slavery to desires, like slavery to sin, where the style guide keeps "slave" because the point is that they were not free.
δουλεύοντες pictures slavery to desires (m2), so "mtumwa" (slave) stands at every level, as the English "slaves" (r-en-1); "mtumishi" would make it sound like willing service.

source.text: ὅτε δὲ ἡ χρηστότης καὶ ἡ φιλανθρωπία ἐπεφάνη τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ, οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων τῶν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ἃ ἐποιήσαμεν ἡμεῖς ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἔσωσεν ἡμᾶς διὰ λουτροῦ παλιγγενεσίας καὶ ἀνακαινώσεως πνεύματος ἁγίου, οὗ ἐξέχεεν ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς πλουσίως διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν, ἵνα δικαιωθέντες τῇ ἐκείνου χάριτι κληρονόμοι γενηθῶμεν κατ’ ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου.

records.literal_gloss: When but the kindness and the love for mankind appeared of the Savior of us God, \v 5 not by works the [ones] in righteousness which did we, but according to his mercy he saved us, through [the] washing of regeneration and renewal of [the] Spirit Holy, \v 6 whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ the Savior of us, \v 7 so that having been justified by the grace of that one, heirs we might become according to [the] hope of life eternal.

en.L: But when the kindness and love for mankind of God our Savior appeared, \v 5 {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved us, not by works done by us in righteousness, but according to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mercy, through the washing of regeneration and renewal of [the] Holy Spirit, \v 6 whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} poured out on us richly through Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} our Savior, \v 7 so that, having been justified by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, we might become heirs according to [the] hope of eternal life.
en.B: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior appeared, \v 5 {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mercy. He saved us through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit, \v 6 whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} poured out on us generously through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} our Savior, \v 7 so that, having been justified by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, we might become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
en.R: But God our Savior showed us how kind {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is and how much {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves people. \v 5 He saved us. It was not because of any righteous things we had done. It was because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had mercy on us. He washed us clean and gave us a new birth. The Holy Spirit made us new. \v 6 God gave us the Holy Spirit generously through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} our Savior. \v 7 Because of God's grace, God has made us right with {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. Now we will receive everything God has promised {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} children. We have the hope of eternal life.

es.L: Pero cuando apareció la bondad y el amor por la humanidad de Dios nuestro Salvador, \v 5 nos salvó, no a partir de obras realizadas en justicia por nosotros, sino conforme a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misericordia, mediante [el] lavado de regeneración y renovación del Espíritu Santo, \v 6 al que vertió sobre nosotros con abundancia por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} nuestro Salvador, \v 7 a fin de que, justificados por la gracia de aquel, llegáramos a ser herederos según [la] esperanza de vida eterna.
es.B: Pero cuando se manifestaron la bondad y el amor de Dios nuestro Salvador, \v 5 nos salvó, no por las obras justas que hubiéramos hecho, sino por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misericordia. Nos salvó mediante el lavado del nuevo nacimiento y la renovación por el Espíritu Santo, \v 6 a quien derramó sobre nosotros con abundancia por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, nuestro Salvador, \v 7 para que, justificados por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, llegáramos a ser herederos con la esperanza de la vida eterna.
es.R: Pero Dios nuestro Salvador nos mostró lo bondadoso que es y cuánto ama a la gente. \v 5 Nos salvó. No fue por ninguna cosa justa que hubiéramos hecho. Fue porque tuvo compasión de nosotros. Nos lavó y nos dio un nuevo nacimiento. El Espíritu Santo nos hizo nuevos. \v 6 Dios nos dio el Espíritu Santo en abundancia por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, nuestro Salvador. \v 7 Por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, Dios nos ha puesto en buena relación consigo. Ahora recibiremos todo lo que Dios ha prometido a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hijos. Tenemos la esperanza de la vida eterna.

fr.L: Mais lorsque la bonté et l’amour pour les humains de Dieu notre Sauveur sont apparus, \v 5 {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a sauvés, non sur la base d’œuvres accomplies par nous dans la justice, mais selon {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} miséricorde, par le bain de la régénération et du renouvellement de l’Esprit Saint, \v 6 qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a répandu sur nous avec abondance par Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} notre Sauveur, \v 7 afin que, justifiés par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, nous devenions héritiers selon l’espérance de la vie éternelle.
fr.B: Mais quand la bonté de Dieu notre Sauveur et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour pour les humains sont apparus, \v 5 {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a sauvés, non à cause d’actes justes que nous aurions accomplis, mais à cause de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} miséricorde. Il nous a sauvés par le bain de la nouvelle naissance et le renouvellement par l’Esprit Saint, \v 6 qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a répandu sur nous avec générosité par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} notre Sauveur, \v 7 afin que, déclarés justes par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, nous devenions héritiers dans l’espérance de la vie éternelle.
fr.R: Mais Dieu notre Sauveur nous a montré combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon et combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aime les gens. \v 5 Il nous a sauvés. Ce n’est pas parce que nous avions fait ce qui est juste. C’est parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a eu pitié de nous. Il nous a lavés et nous a fait naître de nouveau. L’Esprit Saint nous a rendus nouveaux. \v 6 Dieu nous a donné l’Esprit Saint en abondance par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} notre Sauveur. \v 7 Dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, Dieu nous a mis en règle avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Maintenant, nous recevrons tout ce que Dieu a promis à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} enfants. Nous avons l’espérance de la vie éternelle.

sw.L: Lakini wema na upendo kwa binadamu wa Mungu Mwokozi wetu ulipofunuliwa, \v 5 alituokoa, si kwa kazi tulizozifanya sisi katika haki, bali kwa kadiri ya rehema {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, kupitia kuoshwa kwa uzao mpya na kufanywa wapya kwa Roho Mtakatifu, \v 6 ambaye alimmimina juu yetu tele kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Mwokozi wetu, \v 7 ili, tukiwa tumehesabiwa haki kwa neema ya yule, tuwe warithi kwa kadiri ya tumaini la uzima wa milele.
sw.B: Lakini wema na upendo wa Mungu Mwokozi wetu ulipodhihirishwa, \v 5 alituokoa, si kwa sababu ya mambo ya haki tuliyotenda, bali kwa sababu ya rehema {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Alituokoa kupitia kuoshwa kunakoleta kuzaliwa upya na kufanywa wapya na Roho Mtakatifu, \v 6 ambaye alimmimina juu yetu kwa ukarimu kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Mwokozi wetu, \v 7 ili, tukiwa tumehesabiwa haki kwa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, tuwe warithi wenye tumaini la uzima wa milele.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu Mwokozi wetu alituonyesha jinsi alivyo mwema, na jinsi anavyowapenda watu. \v 5 Alituokoa. Haikuwa kwa sababu ya mambo yoyote ya haki tuliyokuwa tumefanya. Ilikuwa kwa sababu alituhurumia. Alituosha akatupa kuzaliwa upya. Roho Mtakatifu alitufanya wapya. \v 6 Mungu alitupa Roho Mtakatifu kwa ukarimu kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Mwokozi wetu. \v 7 Kwa sababu ya neema ya Mungu, Mungu ametufanya kuwa wenye haki mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Sasa tutapokea kila kitu ambacho Mungu amewaahidia watoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Tuna tumaini la uzima wa milele.

decisions.reason: φιλανθρωπία is love for human beings, the root of "philanthropy"; Greek writers praised it in kings and gods.

decisions.choice: not by works, but by his mercy
decisions.reason: As in 2 Timothy 1:9 and Ephesians 2:8-9: salvation rests on God's mercy, not on righteous deeds.

decisions.choice: the washing of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit
alternatives: two acts: washing that brings rebirth, and renewal by the Spirit
decisions.reason: One preposition governs both nouns, so most take it as one washing, which brings new birth and the Spirit's renewal. Many see a reference to baptism (Ephesians 5:26; John 3:5); others a spiritual cleansing that baptism pictures.
παλιγγενεσίας is "becoming again", new birth. Elsewhere it is the renewal of the world (Matthew 19:28).
The words recall Joel 2:28 ("I will pour out my Spirit"), cited at Pentecost (Acts 2:17, 2:33).

decisions.choice: his grace: by that one's grace
decisions.reason: ἐκείνου is "that one", and may mean God or Christ, the nearest named. Either way the grace is God's gift in Christ.
Title setting.
Balanced uses the plainer English (m4).

decisions.choice: nos salvó; consigo (R): no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English has {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved us and, in Readable, "with {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}". Spanish leaves the subject in the verb ("nos salvó") and fuses "con" and the reflexive into "consigo", so neither has a free pronoun to capitalise. Literal says "la gracia de aquel" for the Greek "that one's grace" (m6).

decisions.choice: lavado de regeneración (L); lavado del nuevo nacimiento (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "regeneración" and leaves the link with "renovación" as open as the Greek (m3); Balanced says "nuevo nacimiento", as the English says "new birth" (r-en-2). "Lavado" is today's word; "lavamiento" is archaic.

decisions.choice: justifiés (L); déclarés justes (B); mis en règle avec Dieu (R) (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The terms of the style guide (§9): "justifier" is the technical word, Balanced says what it means in a law court, and Readable follows the English "made us right with himself".
The form used across the French New Testament of this translation (style guide §9).

"Kuhesabiwa haki" (to be counted righteous) keeps the key term "haki" for δικαιωθέντες and says that God declares us in the right. Readable says "ametufanya kuwa wenye haki mbele yake", as the English Readable says "made us right with himself".

The English has {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved us. Swahili carries the subject in the verb (a-li-tu-okoa), which cannot take a capital, so the span appears only on the possessives (rehema zake, neema yake). Literal says "neema ya yule" for the Greek "that one's grace" (m6).

source.text: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος, καὶ περὶ τούτων βούλομαί σε διαβεβαιοῦσθαι, ἵνα φροντίζωσιν καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι οἱ πεπιστευκότες θεῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Trustworthy [is] the saying, and concerning these things I want you to insist, so that may be careful good works to devote themselves to those having believed God.

en.L: The saying [is] trustworthy, and I want you to insist on these things, so that those who have believed God may be careful to devote themselves to good works.
en.B: This saying is trustworthy. I want you to insist on these things, so that those who have believed in God will be careful to devote themselves to doing good.
en.R: What I have told you is true. I want you to keep teaching these things, so that the people who believe in God will be careful to always do good things.

es.L: Digna de confianza [es] la palabra, y sobre estas cosas quiero que hables con plena seguridad, para que los que han creído a Dios se preocupen de dedicarse a obras buenas.
es.B: Este dicho es digno de confianza. Quiero que insistas en estas cosas, para que los que han creído en Dios se esfuercen por dedicarse a hacer el bien.
es.R: Lo que te he dicho es verdad. Quiero que sigas enseñando estas cosas, para que los que creen en Dios se preocupen por hacer siempre el bien.

fr.L: Parole digne de foi, et sur ces choses je veux que tu insistes, afin que ceux qui ont cru Dieu veillent à s’appliquer aux œuvres bonnes.
fr.B: Cette parole est sûre. Je veux que tu insistes sur ces choses, afin que ceux qui ont cru en Dieu veillent à se consacrer à faire le bien.
fr.R: Ce que je t’ai dit est vrai. Je veux que tu continues à enseigner ces choses, pour que ceux qui croient en Dieu fassent attention à toujours faire le bien.

sw.L: Neno [hili] ni la kuaminika, na kuhusu mambo haya nataka uyasisitize kwa uthabiti, ili wale waliomwamini Mungu wajali kujitoa kwa kazi njema.
sw.B: Msemo huu ni wa kuaminika. Nataka usisitize mambo haya, ili wale waliomwamini Mungu wawe waangalifu kujitoa kutenda mema.
sw.R: Haya niliyokuambia ni kweli. Nataka uendelee kuyafundisha mambo haya, ili watu wanaomwamini Mungu wawe waangalifu kutenda mema siku zote.

decisions.reason: The "trustworthy saying" is the summary of salvation just given (verses 4-7), as in 1 Timothy 1:15 and 2 Timothy 2:11.
προΐστασθαι means to lead, or to give oneself to. Some read "practice honorable trades"; most read devotion to good works, the theme of the letter (1:16, 2:7, 2:14, 3:1, 3:14).

source.text: ταῦτά ἐστιν καλὰ καὶ ὠφέλιμα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις·

records.literal_gloss: These things are good and profitable for men.

en.L: These things are excellent and profitable for {{gender:people|men}}.
en.B: These things are excellent and useful for everyone.
en.R: These things are good, and they help people.

es.L: Estas cosas son buenas y provechosas para {{gender:las personas|los hombres}}.
es.B: Estas cosas son excelentes y útiles para todos.
es.R: Estas cosas son buenas, y ayudan a la gente.

fr.L: Ces choses sont belles et utiles aux {{gender:humains|hommes}}.
fr.B: Voilà ce qui est excellent et utile pour tous.
fr.R: Ces choses sont bonnes, et elles aident les gens.

sw.L: Mambo haya ni mazuri na yenye faida kwa watu.
sw.B: Mambo haya ni bora na yanafaa kwa kila mtu.
sw.R: Mambo haya ni mazuri, nayo yanawasaidia watu.

decisions.reason: ἀνθρώποις is the general word for human beings.
The word means human beings in general (m1).

source.text: μωρὰς δὲ ζητήσεις καὶ γενεαλογίας καὶ ἔρεις καὶ μάχας νομικὰς περιΐστασο, εἰσὶν γὰρ ἀνωφελεῖς καὶ μάταιοι.

records.literal_gloss: Foolish but controversies and genealogies and strife and quarrels about the law avoid; they are for unprofitable and worthless.

en.L: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and strife and quarrels about the law, for they are unprofitable and worthless.
en.B: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments and quarrels about the law, because these are unprofitable and useless.
en.R: But stay away from foolish arguments, and from long lists of ancestors that people argue about. Do not get into arguments and fights about the Law of Moses. These things do not help anyone, and they are worthless.

es.L: Pero apártate de las controversias necias y de las genealogías y de las rivalidades y de los pleitos sobre la ley, porque no aprovechan y son vanos.
es.B: Pero evita las controversias necias, las genealogías, las discusiones y las peleas sobre la ley, porque no sirven de nada y son inútiles.
es.R: Pero aléjate de las discusiones tontas y de las largas listas de antepasados sobre las que la gente discute. No te metas en discusiones ni peleas sobre la ley de Moisés. Esas cosas no ayudan a nadie, y no valen nada.

fr.L: Mais évite les controverses folles, et les généalogies, et les disputes, et les querelles sur la Loi, car elles sont inutiles et vaines.
fr.B: Mais évite les controverses folles, les généalogies, les disputes et les querelles au sujet de la Loi, car elles sont sans profit et vaines.
fr.R: Mais tiens-toi loin des discussions stupides, et des longues listes d’ancêtres dont les gens discutent. Ne te lance pas dans des disputes et des bagarres sur la Loi de Moïse. Ces choses n’aident personne, et elles ne valent rien.

sw.L: Lakini ujitenge na mabishano ya kijinga, na nasaba, na ugomvi, na mapigano juu ya sheria, kwa sababu hayafai kitu na ni bure.
sw.B: Lakini epuka mabishano ya kijinga, nasaba, ugomvi na mapigano kuhusu sheria, kwa sababu hayana faida wala maana.
sw.R: Lakini kaa mbali na mabishano ya kijinga, na orodha ndefu za mababu ambazo watu hubishana juu yake. Usijiingize katika mabishano na mapigano kuhusu sheria ya Musa. Mambo hayo hayamsaidii mtu yeyote, na hayana thamani.

decisions.reason: Probably speculations built on the family lists of the Old Testament, as in 1 Timothy 1:4.

decisions.choice: about the law: the law of Moses
decisions.reason: νομικὰς is "legal": arguments about the interpretation of the Jewish law (1:10, 1:14).

source.text: αἱρετικὸν ἄνθρωπον μετὰ μίαν καὶ δευτέραν νουθεσίαν παραιτοῦ, εἰδὼς ὅτι ἐξέστραπται ὁ τοιοῦτος καὶ ἁμαρτάνει, ὢν αὐτοκατάκριτος.

records.literal_gloss: A divisive man after one and a second warning reject, \v 11 knowing that is perverted such a one and sins, being self-condemned.

en.L: As for a divisive person, after a first and second warning, have nothing more to do with [them], \v 11 knowing that such a person is perverted and sins, being self-condemned.
en.B: Warn a divisive person once, and then a second time. After that, have nothing more to do with them. \v 11 You can be sure that such a person is twisted and sinful, and condemns themselves.
en.R: If someone causes divisions in the church, warn them once, then warn them again. If they do not stop, have nothing more to do with them. \v 11 You know that a person like that has turned away from what is right. They keep on sinning, and they show that they are guilty.

es.L: A la persona que causa divisiones, después de una primera y una segunda advertencia, no [la] trates más, \v 11 sabiendo que alguien así está torcido y peca, y se condena a sí mismo.
es.B: Advierte a la persona que causa divisiones una vez, y luego una segunda vez. Después de eso, no tengas nada más que ver con ella. \v 11 Puedes estar seguro de que alguien así está pervertido y es pecador, y se condena a sí mismo.
es.R: Si alguien causa divisiones en la iglesia, adviértele una vez, y luego vuelve a advertirle. Si no deja de hacerlo, no tengas nada más que ver con esa persona. \v 11 Tú sabes que alguien así se ha apartado de lo que es correcto. Sigue pecando, y demuestra que es culpable.

fr.L: Quant à quelqu’un qui cause des divisions, après un premier et un second avertissement, n’aie plus affaire à lui, \v 11 sachant que quelqu’un de tel est perverti et pèche, étant condamné par lui-même.
fr.B: Avertis une fois, puis une deuxième fois, celui qui provoque des divisions. Ensuite, n’aie plus rien à faire avec lui. \v 11 Tu peux être sûr que quelqu’un comme lui est dévoyé et pécheur, et qu’il se condamne lui-même.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un provoque des divisions dans l’église, avertis-le une fois, puis avertis-le encore. S’il ne s’arrête pas, n’aie plus rien à faire avec lui. \v 11 Tu sais que quelqu’un comme lui s’est détourné de ce qui est juste. Il continue à pécher, et il montre lui-même qu’il est coupable.

sw.L: Mtu mwenye kuleta mafarakano, baada ya onyo la kwanza na la pili, ujitenge naye, \v 11 ukijua kwamba mtu wa namna hiyo amepotoka na anatenda dhambi, akiwa amejihukumu mwenyewe.
sw.B: Mwonye mtu anayeleta mafarakano mara moja, kisha mara ya pili. Baada ya hapo usijihusishe naye tena. \v 11 Unaweza kuwa na hakika kwamba mtu wa namna hiyo amepotoka, ni mwenye dhambi, na anajihukumu mwenyewe.
sw.R: Mtu akileta mafarakano kanisani, mwonye mara moja, kisha mwonye tena. Asipoacha, usijihusishe naye tena. \v 11 Unajua kwamba mtu kama huyo ameacha njia iliyo sawa. Anaendelea kutenda dhambi, na anaonyesha kwamba ana hatia.

decisions.reason: αἱρετικὸν describes one who causes factions; the later sense "heretic" grew from it.
ἄνθρωπον is the general word for a human being, so all levels say "person".
Compare Jesus' steps of correction in Matthew 18:15-17.
The words are general (m2), so the English is general.

decisions.choice: "quelqu’un qui", "celui qui" … "lui", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The words are general (m2). The English needs "person … them" for that; French "quelqu’un" and "celui qui" already mean anyone, and the "lui" that refers back to them is ordinary generic French (style guide §7), so no span is needed.

source.text: Ὅταν πέμψω Ἀρτεμᾶν πρὸς σὲ ἢ Τυχικόν, σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με εἰς Νικόπολιν, ἐκεῖ γὰρ κέκρικα παραχειμάσαι.

records.literal_gloss: When I send Artemas to you or Tychicus, make every effort to come to me in Nicopolis, there for I have decided to winter.

en.L: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there.
en.B: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to spend the winter there.
en.R: I will send Artemas or Tychicus to you. When one of them comes, try hard to come to me at Nicopolis. I have decided to stay there for the winter.

es.L: Cuando envíe a Artemas a ti, o a Tíquico, esfuérzate por venir a mí a Nicópolis, porque allí he decidido invernar.
es.B: Cuando te envíe a Artemas o a Tíquico, haz todo lo posible por venir a verme a Nicópolis, porque he decidido pasar allí el invierno.
es.R: Te voy a enviar a Artemas o a Tíquico. Cuando uno de ellos llegue, haz todo lo posible por venir a verme a Nicópolis. He decidido quedarme allí durante el invierno.

fr.L: Quand je t’enverrai Artémas ou Tychique, efforce-toi de venir auprès de moi à Nicopolis, car c’est là que j’ai décidé de passer l’hiver.
fr.B: Quand je t’aurai envoyé Artémas ou Tychique, fais ton possible pour venir me rejoindre à Nicopolis, car j’ai décidé d’y passer l’hiver.
fr.R: Je vais t’envoyer Artémas ou Tychique. Quand l’un d’eux arrivera, essaie vraiment de venir me voir à Nicopolis. J’ai décidé d’y rester pour l’hiver.

sw.L: Wakati nitakapomtuma kwako Artema au Tikiko, fanya bidii uje kwangu Nikopoli, kwa sababu huko nimekata shauri kukaa majira ya baridi.
sw.B: Nitakapomtuma Artema au Tikiko kwako, fanya kila uwezalo uje kwangu Nikopoli, kwa sababu nimeamua kukaa huko kipindi cha baridi.
sw.R: Nitamtuma Artema au Tikiko kwako. Mmoja wao akifika, jitahidi sana uje kwangu Nikopoli. Nimeamua kukaa huko wakati wote wa baridi.

decisions.reason: Artemas is mentioned only here. Tychicus was Paul's trusted messenger (Ephesians 6:21; Colossians 4:7; 2 Timothy 4:12). One of them would take Titus' place in Crete.
Several cities had this name ("City of Victory"); most likely the one in Epirus, on the western coast of Greece.

source.text: ζηνᾶν τὸν νομικὸν καὶ Ἀπολλῶν σπουδαίως πρόπεμψον, ἵνα μηδὲν αὐτοῖς λείπῃ.

records.literal_gloss: Zenas the lawyer and Apollos diligently send on, so that nothing for them may be lacking.

en.L: Diligently send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way, so that they lack nothing.
en.B: Do everything you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way, and see that they have everything they need.
en.R: Zenas the lawyer and Apollos are going on a trip. Do all you can to help them, so that they have everything they need.

es.L: A Zenas, el experto en la ley, y a Apolos, ayúda[los] con esmero a seguir su viaje, para que no les falte nada.
es.B: Haz todo lo posible por ayudar a Zenas, el experto en la ley, y a Apolos a seguir su viaje, y procura que tengan todo lo que necesiten.
es.R: Zenas, el experto en la ley, y Apolos van a salir de viaje. Haz todo lo que puedas para ayudarlos, para que tengan todo lo que necesiten.

fr.L: Pourvois avec soin au départ de Zénas le juriste et d’Apollos, afin que rien ne leur manque.
fr.B: Fais tout ton possible pour aider Zénas le juriste et Apollos à poursuivre leur voyage, et veille à ce qu’ils ne manquent de rien.
fr.R: Zénas le juriste et Apollos partent en voyage. Fais tout ce que tu peux pour les aider, pour qu’ils aient tout ce dont ils ont besoin.

sw.L: Zena, yule mtaalamu wa sheria, na Apolo, uwapeleke njiani kwa juhudi, ili wasikose chochote.
sw.B: Fanya kila uwezalo kuwasaidia Zena mtaalamu wa sheria na Apolo katika safari yao, na uhakikishe kwamba wana kila kitu wanachohitaji.
sw.R: Zena, mtaalamu wa sheria, na Apolo wanasafiri. Fanya kila uwezalo kuwasaidia, ili wawe na kila kitu wanachohitaji.

decisions.reason: Zenas is mentioned only here; "lawyer" may mean an expert in Jewish law or in Roman law. Apollos was the eloquent teacher from Alexandria (Acts 18:24-28; 1 Corinthians 3:6). They may have carried this letter.

decisions.choice: send on their way: equip for a journey
decisions.reason: προπέμπω means to send someone on with food, money and help for travel (Romans 15:24; 3 John 6).
The book-wide term for νομικός. It can name a Roman lawyer or an expert in the law of Moses (m1), and "experto en la ley" leaves both open, where "abogado" would choose the first.
The book-wide term for νομικός. It can name a Roman lawyer or an expert in the law of Moses (m1), and "mtaalamu wa sheria" leaves both open, where "wakili" (an advocate) would choose the first.

source.text: μανθανέτωσαν δὲ καὶ οἱ ἡμέτεροι καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι εἰς τὰς ἀναγκαίας χρείας, ἵνα μὴ ὦσιν ἄκαρποι.

records.literal_gloss: Let learn but also ours good works to devote themselves to for the necessary needs, so that not they may be unfruitful.

en.L: And let our people also learn to devote themselves to good works for urgent needs, so that they may not be unfruitful.
en.B: Our people must also learn to devote themselves to doing good, so that they can meet urgent needs and not be unfruitful.
en.R: Our people must learn to always do good things, so that they can help others when they need it. Then their lives will be useful.

es.L: Que aprendan también los nuestros a entregarse a obras buenas para atender necesidades apremiantes, a fin de que no queden sin fruto.
es.B: Los nuestros también deben aprender a dedicarse a hacer el bien, para que puedan atender las necesidades urgentes y no vivan sin dar fruto.
es.R: Nuestra gente debe aprender a hacer siempre el bien, para que puedan ayudar a otros cuando lo necesiten. Así sus vidas serán útiles.

fr.L: Et que les nôtres aussi apprennent à s’appliquer aux œuvres bonnes pour les besoins pressants, afin qu’ils ne soient pas sans fruit.
fr.B: Les nôtres doivent aussi apprendre à se consacrer à faire le bien, pour répondre aux besoins urgents et ne pas rester sans fruit.
fr.R: Les croyants de chez nous doivent apprendre à toujours faire le bien, pour pouvoir aider les autres quand ils en ont besoin. Alors leur vie sera utile.

sw.L: Na watu wetu pia wajifunze kujitoa kwa kazi njema kwa ajili ya mahitaji ya lazima, ili wasiwe bila matunda.
sw.B: Watu wetu pia wajifunze kujitoa kutenda mema, ili waweze kukidhi mahitaji ya dharura na wasiwe bila matunda.
sw.R: Watu wetu wajifunze kutenda mema siku zote, ili waweze kuwasaidia wengine wanapohitaji msaada. Ndipo maisha yao yatakuwa na manufaa.

decisions.choice: our people: the believers in Crete
decisions.reason: ἡμέτεροι is "ours": the believers, in contrast to the false teachers.
As in verse 8; here it is linked with meeting urgent needs, such as those of Zenas and Apollos.

source.text: Ἀσπάζονταί σε οἱ μετ’ ἐμοῦ πάντες.

records.literal_gloss: Greet you those with me all.

en.L: All who are with me greet you.
en.B: Everyone with me sends you greetings.
en.R: Everyone here with me says hello to you.

es.L: Te saludan todos los que [están] conmigo.
es.B: Todos los que están conmigo te envían saludos.
es.R: Todos los que están aquí conmigo te mandan saludos.

fr.L: Tous ceux qui sont avec moi te saluent.
fr.B: Tous ceux qui sont avec moi t’envoient leurs salutations.
fr.R: Tous ceux qui sont ici avec moi te disent bonjour.

sw.B: Wote walio hapa pamoja nami wanakutumia salamu.
sw.R: Kila mtu aliye hapa pamoja nami anakusalimu.

decisions.reason: σε is singular; the final blessing (s3) is plural.

source.text: ἄσπασαι τοὺς φιλοῦντας ἡμᾶς ἐν πίστει.

records.literal_gloss: Greet those loving us in faith.

en.L: Greet those who love us in [the] faith.
en.B: Greet those who love us in the faith.
en.R: Say hello to the believers there who love us and share our faith.

es.L: Saluda a los que nos aman en [la] fe.
es.B: Saluda a los que nos aman en la fe.
es.R: Saluda a los creyentes de allí que nos aman y comparten nuestra fe.

fr.L: Salue ceux qui nous aiment dans la foi.
fr.B: Salue ceux qui nous aiment dans la foi.
fr.R: Dis bonjour aux croyants de chez toi qui nous aiment et qui partagent notre foi.

sw.R: Nisalimie waumini walio huko wanaotupenda na kushiriki imani yetu.

decisions.choice: in the faith: as fellow believers
decisions.reason: πίστει without the article may mean "in the faith" (as believers) or "faithfully".

records.literal_gloss: The grace [be] with all of you.

en.B: Grace be with all of you.
en.R: I pray that God will show grace to all of you.

es.R: Pido que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} muestre su gracia a todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.B: Que la grâce soit avec vous tous.
fr.R: Je prie pour que Dieu vous montre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, à vous tous.

sw.R: Ninaomba Mungu awaonyeshe neema ninyi nyote.

decisions.choice: you: plural, the church with Titus
decisions.reason: ὑμῶν is plural: the letter is personal, but read in the churches.
Many manuscripts add "Amen".

The rest of the letter speaks to Titus alone ("tú"); this last greeting is to the whole church with him (m1), so the plural "you" becomes the reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain).
